title: Marlowe Fire Dispatch: Dairy Lane Closure, Engine 2 Route

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Campus Police Operations Console 1

transcript.speaker: Marlowe Fire
transcript.text: MSU, Marlowe Fire dispatch. Your Facilities folks put out that the Mill Street gauge just went over six and a half, and we hear you're closing Dairy Lane. Is that right, and what time did it close?

transcript.speaker: Marlowe Fire
transcript.text: Okay. Here's my problem. Dairy Lane is our first-due route to the south side of your campus. That's Riverside, the Sugar Run Apartments, Lot C, all of it. Which alternate route do you want Engine 2 and the medic units to use until this is over?

transcript.speaker: Marlowe Fire
transcript.text: And is Mill Street over the culvert staying open? Our captain says the water's already high at the culvert mouth. I don't want to send an engine across it and then have you close it behind them.

transcript.speaker: Marlowe Fire
transcript.text: Last thing. Are you putting an officer at the Dairy Lane barricade, and where do you want our units to stage if you need us on the south side? I need one location I can give every crew.

transcript.speaker: Marlowe Fire
transcript.text: Copy. I'll put that out to our units now. Call us back the minute any of that changes.

voiceStyles.Marlowe Fire: Man in his 30s, calm and efficient public-safety dispatcher, other radio traffic murmuring in the room behind him, speaks briskly and waits for each answer

instructorNote: Before you play this call, put the 07:02 dashboard alarm on screen (STAGE 6.51 ft, DAIRY LANE CLOSURE STAGE (6.5) EXCEEDED; 06:50 6.15, 06:40 5.85, 06:30 5.55; RISING +1.8 ft/hr). At 07:08, have the SimCell play the diesel supplier's dispatcher calling the central plant: "Our driver is already loaded and on the road for your 08:00. He's routed over Dairy Lane unless someone has told us otherwise. If it's closed, tell me now where you want him, or he turns around and the next slot is tomorrow afternoon." Watch for three things: CPD closes and staffs Dairy Lane under EOP Annex F 5.1 and logs the time. CPD gives Marlowe Fire a recommended alternate route and a single staging point, and doesn't send them over the Mill Street culvert. Fac re-routes the tanker or delivers to Kessler first to protect the generator day tank, then reports the arrival time to the IC.
